summary: End-to-end testing of niche-aware Super Search prompt routing (Item 1), Super Search defaulting OFF across templates + new value-prop copy (Item 2), and 503-guard / worker-status regressions. All 5 backend pytest cases PASSED and all 5 frontend Playwright assertions PASSED. Static source verification confirmed: PHYSICAL_PRODUCT_NICHES == {'tech_gadgets','ecommerce_amazon'}; ss_system_prompt_saas contains 'B2B SaaS affiliate discovery platform' (1x) and 'Amazon FBA' (1x) but NOT 'physical-product affiliate'; ss_system_prompt_physical contains 'physical-product affiliate discovery platform', 'Multiple Amazon Associates links detected in last 90 days', 'unboxing', the ASMR carve-out 'faceless ASMR or overhead-shot product-demo content with active affiliate links DOES qualify' (newline-wrapped in source but semantically intact); only the anti-conflation NOTE references Amazon-FBA — the red-flags section is FBA-free. Routing conditional ss_system_prompt = (ss_system_prompt_physical if req.niche in PHYSICAL_PRODUCT_NICHES else ss_system_prompt_saas) is present in /app/backend/server.py:2913-2917. Runtime smoke confirmed POST /api/channels/enrich for both niches returns 200, no 500/traceback in backend logs around the requests. Frontend: super-search-switch is data-state='unchecked' immediately after applying both product-gadget-reviewers and saas-tool-reviewers templates; super-search-value-prop renders the exact required copy and sits at DOM index 1 of 3 paragraphs (between 'Run GPT-4o grading…' and 'Costs 12 credits…'). Niche-scoped regressions still pass: tech_gadgets shows product-gadget-reviewers + partnerstack-reverse cards; fitness_health shows template-empty-niche-hint. The Super Search toggle card lives inside the collapsed 'Advanced Settings' section — testing required expanding it (note for future iterations).
critical_code_review_comments: The spec referenced POST /api/channels/search but the actual endpoint is POST /api/channels/enrich (with /api/search returning channel_ids first). No code defect — adjust spec/internal docs if these are referenced elsewhere.

Super Search toggle is inside the 'Advanced Settings' collapsible region, so users (and tests) must expand that section to see it. Consider documenting this — current playbook for Super Search assumes it is directly visible.
/var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log keeps emitting a pre-existing passlib/bcrypt 'module has no attribute __about__' warning — harmless but noisy, unrelated to this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend search/super-search pipeline lives in POST /api/channels/enrich (not /api/channels/search). Response field for super-search meta is response['super_search'] (not super_search_meta). Pipeline returns null for super_search key when channels list is empty (early return at server.py:2264-2267) — to validate runtime routing, first hit /api/search to obtain channel_ids then enrich them. Frontend: Super Search toggle is inside the collapsible Advanced Settings section on the dashboard SearchPanel — expand it before asserting on data-testid='super-search-switch'. data-testids confirmed: super-search-switch, super-search-value-prop, change-template-btn, niche-{key}, template-card-{id}, template-empty-niche-hint, clear-mismatched-template-btn. A cookies banner can intercept clicks on first visit — click Accept first. Backend on supervisor sometimes leaves a zombie reload state if files inside /app/backend get touched (uvicorn watchfiles); keep test files in /app/tests, not /app/backend/tests.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found; all spec invariants validated.
